name: DramaLens
tagline: Local-first timestamped transcription and analysis for short-form drama
description: DramaLens is a Chrome extension that transcribes and analyzes short-form drama with timestamps, entirely local-first under an AGPL-3.0 license. It targets the growing genre of short-form drama content, giving viewers timestamped transcripts and analysis without shipping their media to a cloud. Privacy-first media analysis for a content format that has exploded in popularity.
highlights: Local-first processing — media stays on your machine
curatorNote: Short-form drama is a massive content category with almost no good tooling. A local-first transcription extension is both timely and privacy-respecting.
